title: Pass 3 chemo-mechanical ridge-elevation reference for 2012-economou-palate-ruguga-turing.py: quasi-static Kirchhoff epithelial plate on a Winkler mesenchymal foundation driven by the FGF/SHH Turing field
remediates: 2026-10-19-palate-ruguga-turing-audit-v2 remediation item 1: couple the 2D epithelial-mesenchymal FGF-SHH reaction-diffusion sheet to mechanical epithelial thickening (placode invagination) to simulate 3D palatal ridge elevation
scope_statement: Reduced 2.5D model: the epithelial mid-surface elevation h(x, y) is solved as a linear thin plate on an elastic foundation under a chemically prescribed active thickening load. It is solved EXACTLY on the finite-difference grid (DCT-II eigen-solver, zero-flux edges). It is NOT a 3D finite-element simulation of epithelial invagination with large deflections or nonlinear growth; that residual is carried as an open Pass 4 remediation item.

governing_equation.quasi_static_plate: kappa * Lap^2 h - T * Lap h + k_f * h = beta * max(A - A_th, 0)
governing_equation.transfer_stiffness: S(q^2) = kappa * q^4 + T * q^2 + k_f   (S >= k_f > 0, monotone non-decreasing in q^2)
governing_equation.fourier_solution: h_q = beta * f_q / S(q^2)   (sign-preserving low-pass filter of the chemical forcing)
governing_equation.mechanical_feedback: dA/dt += chi_mech * (h - <h>)   (optional two-way coupling; default chi_mech = 0)
governing_equation.discrete_laplacian_eigenvalues: lam_k = (2 - 2 cos(pi k / n)) / dx^2 for the 5-point zero-flux Laplacian (DCT-II basis)

sources.citation: Landau LD, Lifshitz EM (1986). Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed. (Course of Theoretical Physics Vol. 7), Pergamon Press, Sec. 11-14 (equilibrium of thin plates; bending stiffness kappa = E h_0^3 / 12 (1 - nu^2)).
sources.role: Thin-plate (Kirchhoff) bending equation and bending stiffness definition

sources.citation: Economou AD et al. (2012). Nature Genetics 44(3):348-351. Fig. 1 (Shh in situ marks each morphological ruga), Fig. 2 (explant incisions).
sources.role: Empirical constraint that morphological rugae (epithelial thickenings / ridges) coincide with the Shh stripes, i.e. zero crest-to-stripe phase offset, and that the wild-type mouse palate carries 9 rugae

baseline_parameters.units: dimensionless: h in units of the resting epithelial thickness h_0; lengths in the AP units of the RD grid (L_ap = 29, 9 rugae => lambda_ap ~ 3.2); the four stiffness/gain constants are modelling choices chosen so that the transfer gain at the ruga wavenumber G(q_ap) = 1 / S(q_ap^2) is O(0.4), not literature measurements
baseline_parameters.provenance_note: No published measurement of mouse palatal epithelial bending stiffness, tension or mesenchymal foundation stiffness was available offline; the values above are dimensionless modelling assumptions and are exposed to the kappa / k_f / chi_mech sweeps below so that their qualitative predictions (sign preservation, wavelength transfer, monotone attenuation) rather than their magnitudes are what the audit scores.

kappa_bending_stiffness.expected: ridge amplitude strictly decreasing (Spearman rho = -1); ridge count locked at 9 for kappa <= 0.1 (wavelength transfer) and merging to 7 for kappa >= 0.2 (over-stiff epithelium low-pass-merges the two shortest-spaced crests); crest phase offset < 0.03 wavelength throughout

k_found_foundation_stiffness.expected: ridge amplitude strictly decreasing (Spearman rho = -1); ridge count locked at 9

chi_mech_feedback.expected: two-way coupling: wild-type ruga count stays 9; ridge amplitude non-decreasing in chi_mech

wild_type_ridge_count.source: Economou et al. (2012) Fig. 1a; Pantalacci et al. (2008) Fig. 1 (rugae 8, 1-7, 7b)

crest_to_shh_stripe_phase_offset.source: Economou et al. (2012) Fig. 1: Shh expression is confined to the epithelium of each morphological ruga

specimen_ridge_duty_cycle.method: scipy.signal.peak_widths(rel_height=0.5) on the sigma=8 px smoothed DoG anteroposterior ridge profile of the left (and right) palatal shelf ROI of palate_rugae_specimen.jpg, divided by the mean inter-ruga spacing
specimen_ridge_duty_cycle.source: datasets/palate_ruguga_turing/palate_rugae_specimen.jpg (Wikimedia Commons File:Palatum_horse.JPG, CC BY-SA 3.0); value is computed at runtime and reported, not pinned
specimen_ridge_duty_cycle.caveat: Equus caballus adult specimen vs Mus musculus embryonic model; DoG band-pass filtering and sigma=8 px smoothing broaden the apparent crest width, so the comparison is qualitative (both < 0.5, i.e. crests narrower than a sinusoid)
